conversation.user: My contractor says the hempcrete itself can support the roof, so I can skip the timber frame. Is that right?
conversation.assistant:
That is actually incorrect; hempcrete is strictly a non-load-bearing infill material, meaning a conventional timber or structural frame must carry all roof and floor loads. Hempcrete is fantastic for insulation and breathability, but it needs that skeletal frame to hold up the building. 

To help make sure your framing plan is safe and up to code, what stage of planning or engineering are you currently in?
